image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a white audio cassette tape. The image shows the two circular spools with magnetic tape, a central label area with orange handwritten text, and molded plastic details including screw holes and write-protect tabs. The top edge shows some faint text or branding.

artifact_observations.location: Central label area and top edge
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the central label is nonsensical scribbles rather than legible characters. Faint text at the top is also distorted. This is a common AI artifact where text structure is mimicked but content is not generated correctly.
The teeth on the white spools lack sharp, mechanical definition and appear slightly melted or soft. The boundary between the dark tape and the white spool is slightly blurry.

artifact_observations.location: Left side of the cassette body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The left vertical edge of the cassette casing seems to warp slightly inward near the middle, deviating from the expected straight rigid line of a plastic enclosure.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cassette and not a similar rectangular object.
To rigorously analyze the gibberish text artifacts observed on the label and top edge.
To verify the structural integrity of the plastic shell and check for melting or fusion artifacts at the edges.
To assess the overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global distortions.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on the label
Sharpness and mechanical correctness of spool teeth
Straightness and rigidity of the cassette casing edges
Consistency of plastic texture and reflections
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text generation quality. AI models often fail to render coherent text on labels. Also, inspect the mechanical precision of the spools; AI often generates 'soft' or irregular teeth on gears/spools. Check if the casing maintains a rigid rectangular geometry or if it warps.
